pathwayCovered: Provincial Nominee Program — Non-Express Entry process (process/fees/documents only, NOT eligibility criteria)
note: Bu dosya PNP'nin her eyaletin kendi stream/eligibility kriterini İÇERMEZ — o, ayrı bir 'pnp-streams-{province}.json' setinde olacak. Bu dosya sadece IRCC'nin federal düzeyde, hangi eyalet/stream olursa olsun ortak olan BAŞVURU SÜRECİ, ÜCRET ve BELGE bilgisini taşır.

feeTypes.description: Paid for applicant + each included family member
Paid at submission, covers fingerprints + digital photo
Medical exam, police certificates, ECA — paid separately to third parties, not to IRCC

processSteps.name: Get nominated by a province or territory
processSteps.description: Applicant chooses a province/territory and applies under one of its non-Express-Entry streams. Province reviews based on their immigration needs, minimum stream requirements, and genuine intention to live there.

processSteps.name: Get your documents ready
processSteps.description: Principal applicant signs for entire application incl. family members 18+.

processSteps.name: Apply for permanent residence
processSteps.description: Online application via PR Portal, after provincial nomination confirmed.

processSteps.name: After you apply
processSteps.description: AOR issued, biometrics + medical exam requested, eligibility/admissibility assessed.

processSteps.name: Settling in Canada
processSteps.description: COPR issued, PR card mailed, settlement services available.

downloadAndUpload.name: Economic Classes: Provincial Nominees – Business Nominees

conditionalForms.name: Declaration From Non-accompanying Parent/Guardian for Minors
conditionalForms.condition: If a parent of a minor applicant is not coming to Canada

conditionalForms.name: Statutory Declaration of Common-law Union
conditionalForms.condition: If applicant has a common-law partner

supportingDocuments: Photos (taken within 12 months, both sides scanned per portal instructions)
Confirmation of nomination from the province/territory (approval letter or official notice)
Passport/travel document copies (regular passport only — diplomatic/official/service/public-affairs passports NOT valid)
Marriage certificates, divorce/annulment certificates (all marriages if more than one)
Death certificates for former spouses (if applicable)
National ID / family registry book (if applicable)
Common-law evidence: 12+ months cohabitation proof (joint bank statements, leases, utility bills) — required if claiming common-law status
Children's documents: birth certificates showing parents' names, custody proof, adoption papers (if applicable)
Police certificate: required for every country (excl. Canada) where applicant lived 6+ consecutive months since age 18

biometrics.note: Required even if biometrics were previously given and are still valid

medicalExam.appliesTo: applicant + all family members, even non-accompanying ones

decisionCriteria: meets eligibility criteria for the program
has funds to support self and family on arrival
admissible (medical exam, police certificate, background checks)
afterApply.misrepresentationConsequence: Application refusal, inadmissibility finding, and/or 5-year bar from applying for permanent residence

importantCaveats.text: A provincial nomination does NOT itself grant permission to work in Canada. A separate work permit application is required to work while the PR application is processed.

Faster work permit processing available for physicians/healthcare specialists (clinical lab medicine, surgery, general practice/family medicine) with a full-time offer + a support letter from the nominating province/territory.
Available if applicant's existing work permit is about to expire while PR application is still processing.

An immigration representative cannot open a portal account on the applicant's behalf, sign the application electronically, or log in using the applicant's credentials. They can fill forms and communicate via their own account.
